name: Eva Sarkhoff
summary: Outside Scholomance, Eva Sarkhoff lingers with Lucien, her husband, and seeks vengeance for their deaths. Once head maid to House Barov, she asks mortals to destroy their cursed remains.

sections.title: The Fall of House Barov
sections.body:
For decades, Eva served as head maid to the wealthy Barov family at Caer Darrow. Her husband Lucien was the family butler. As the Barovs feared age and the loss of their vast wealth, they made a disastrous pact with Kel'Thuzad. They gradually gave their manor to the young Cult of the Damned, which turned it into Scholomance, a hidden school of necromancy.

Eva and Lucien hid in the keep's corridors for six months. They scavenged food as cultists and monstrosities took over their home.

sections.title: The Butcher's Scalpel
sections.body:
The Scourge found Eva and Lucien, then delivered them to Doctor Theolen Krastinov, known as the Butcher. For weeks, Krastinov tortured them with experiments. Dark magic kept them alive beyond mortal endurance.

After they died, ghouls fed on their corpses. Their restless spirits remained bound to Caer Darrow. Eva now begs travelers to slay Krastinov and burn their remains.

faq.q: Who was Eva Sarkhoff before she died?
faq.answer: For decades, Eva served as head maid to the noble Barov family at Caer Darrow. Her husband Lucien was the family butler.

After months hiding from the Cult of the Damned, Eva and Lucien were found and handed to Doctor Theolen Krastinov. He tortured them for weeks, using dark magic to keep them alive until they died. Ghouls then fed on their corpses.

faq.q: Why is Eva's ghost still in Caer Darrow?
faq.answer: Eva's spirit remains bound to Caer Darrow after her torment. She cannot pass on until Doctor Krastinov is slain and her remains inside Scholomance are burned.

angles.text: As a priest, you see the cruelty of the Scourge in Eva and Lucien's torment. Their restless souls call for holy hands to grant them peace and cleanse the foul magic binding them.
As a human, you see Eva and her husband among Lordaeron's ordinary servants. Their corrupt aristocracy betrayed them when House Barov sold Caer Darrow to Kel'Thuzad.
